# Bundled fonts

| Font | Files | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | `android/ui/src/main/res/font/inter.ttf` (variable, `opsz` and `wght` axes) | [SIL Open Font License 1.1](Inter-OFL.txt) | [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter) |
| Outfit | `android/ui/src/main/res/font/outfit.ttf` (variable, `wght` axis) | [SIL Open Font License 1.1](Outfit-OFL.txt) | [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/outfit) |

The files are unmodified apart from their names, which follow Android resource naming rules.
